adele_fin: Quick note 44d We're proposing an A/B pricing roll with an opt-in grandfather flow. Draft price CSV in Drive: https://drive.company/fin/experiments/price-v4.csv

sam_ops: Ops asks: exclude reserved contracts and marketplace-linked billing entities. Want a soft throttle for treatment cohort for first 7 days and an auto-fallback if billing delta >0.6% in 24h. Also recommend limiting treatment to accounts <7M tokens/mo.

mira_product: Cohort rules: 85% treatment / 15% control for new signups. Auto-grandfather for customers with paid invoices older than 90 days. Provide a Console toggle so legacy customers can opt in manually; sales can request batch opt-ins.

jon_eng: Tech notes: billing-service supports per-customer rate_override. We'll implement a Console toggle (small schema change: boolean "grandfather_opt_in") and a backfill job that issues prorated credits for the remainder of the current invoice only. Dry-run scheduled: 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z. Accounts missing invoice snapshots will be tagged MANUAL_REVIEW.

claire_sales: Sales needs a Console column showing "grandfathered_until" and audit info for manual opt-ins (rep name + ticket id). We'll prepare the exceptions sheet and a short playbook. 48h SLA preferred for manual requests.

billingbot: Snapshot coverage: 95.7%. Missing invoice snapshots: acct_502, acct_707. Recommend archival check: archive_tool --ids acct_502,acct_707

adele_fin: Finance position: no retro credits on closed invoices; only prorated current period credits. Disputes on closed invoices go to RevOps. We'll require legal signoff on messaging and TOS blurb.

sam_ops: I'll post routing and capacity-gating doc in #eng-infra by EOD. Also propose a 1k-account canary for 48h before wider ramp.

jon_eng: Implementation plan: Console patch + metadata field (ETA 3 business days), backfill job (dry-run -> manual review -> live), and a feature-flag to pause the experiment. Need 2 reviewers for deploy: @mira_product and @sam_ops.

mira_product: Approvals required: finance sign-off on credit policy, legal on messaging/TOS, product + eng on rollout steps. Target signoff by Friday COB so we can publish next Wednesday.

claire_sales: We'll prepare email templates for grandfather confirmations and treatment notices, and a one-pager for reps. Marketing to approve copy by Thu.

billingbot: Reminder: staging billing simulation scheduled 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z using cohort file: https://drive.company/fin/cohorts/sim-1k.csv

adele_fin: Thanks all 389 Please add blockers in thread. We'll post final publish note here once approvals come in.
